attempts.prompt:
1990s cel animation style illustration of a high-school student in uniform leaning on a rooftop railing, looking out over the city.
Line quality: bold even black outlines, hand-inked feel.
Shading: flat two-tone cel shading with hard shadow edges, minimal gradients, visible cel paint texture.
Palette: dusk slate #343E49, pale sky #B8C6C4, cream #E1DAD1, steel blue #426A84, warm grey #7F756C, muted silver #99A0A5.
Background: rooftop water tank, chain-link fence and vent pipes in silhouette, city skyline receding into a graduated dusk sky.
Mood: quiet, end of the day, still air.
Composition: figure on the left third of a 16:9 frame, city and sky opening to the right.

Avoid: photorealistic face, 3d render, muddy colors, broken anatomy, extra limbs, modern digital airbrush shading.
attempts.critique: 옥상 난간, 급수탑, 철망 펜스, 배기관, 해질녘 그라데이션 하늘과 도시 원경까지 배경 구성은 레퍼런스와 정확히 맞다. 16:9 구도와 인물의 왼쪽 3분의 1 배치도 지시대로. 감점은 스타일 — 90년대 셀 애니를 요구했는데 음영이 거의 없는 균일한 선의 현대 벡터 일러스트로 나왔다. 2단 셀 셰이딩이 실종됐고 무릎 아래 다리 형태가 어색하다.
attempts.fix: 'two-tone cel shading with a hard shadow terminator on the face, uniform under-shadow on the skirt and legs'를 명시하고, 'vector-flat, no shading'을 네거티브에 추가할 것.
